project.name: DPA Image Toolkit
project.tagline: Desktop toolkit for archival image cleanup and TIFF workflow management
project.summary: A Windows-first desktop toolkit for archival imaging workflows. The app combines Auto Crop, Merge TIFFs, Split TIFFs, Add Border, OCR to PDF, and PDF Conversion in one CustomTkinter GUI, with deploy-ready copies kept under deploy/.

highlights.detail: Auto Crop, Merge TIFFs, Split TIFFs, Add Border, OCR to PDF, PDF Conversion

tools.name: Auto Crop
tools.summary: Detects content and crops away scanner-created white space while retaining all meaningful detected content in one crop region.
tools.inputs: Folder of TIFF, JPEG, PNG, BMP, or GIF images
notes: Best results come from scans on white or near-white backgrounds.
Uses a 253 threshold and unions meaningful contours before padding.
Padding rule: 2.5% of image size, clamped to 15–100 px.

tools.name: Merge TIFFs
tools.summary: Builds multi-page TIFFs from page files grouped by naming pattern.
tools.inputs: Folder of TIFF files named like {name}_{group}_{###}.tif or .tiff
notes: Valid groups are merged in numeric order.
Mixed folders are allowed; unmatched TIFFs are skipped with warnings.
Output DPI comes from the first valid file in each group.

tools.name: Split TIFFs
tools.summary: Extracts each page of a multi-page TIFF into an individual single-page TIFF.
tools.inputs: Selected TIFF files or a folder containing TIFF files
notes: Single-page TIFFs are skipped automatically.
Useful when archives receive multi-page masters that need page-level access.
Preserves DPI when source metadata is available.

tools.name: Add Border
tools.summary: Adds a white border around every image in a selected folder using the same spacing logic as Auto Crop.
notes: Intended for workflows such as book scans or presentation-ready images.
Leaves original images untouched.
Uses the same 2.5% padding rule as Auto Crop.

tools.name: OCR to PDF
tools.summary: Groups scan files by trailing four-digit sequence and creates searchable PDFs in a PDFs subfolder.
tools.inputs: Folder of supported scan images named like {name}_####.<extension>
notes: Valid single files are still processed as one-page PDFs.
Defaults to English OCR on the local Tesseract install.
With quality precheck enabled, flagged pages stay in output PDFs but are included without OCR text.
Supports per-page and per-job progress plus exported run logs.

tools.name: PDF Conversion
tools.summary: Reduce PDF size, split pages, export page images, and extract page ranges.
tools.inputs: Single PDF file or a folder of PDFs (operation-dependent)
notes: Uses the same compression profiles as OCR PDF for consistent output expectations.
Split PDF and Extract Pages are single-file operations in the current UI.
Extract can optionally remove extracted pages from the source PDF.
JPEG/PNG/TIFF page export uses pypdfium2 rendering.

hcrInvestigation.decision: TBD — need to decide whether this belongs in the main OCR tool or a dedicated HCR panel. Benchmark samples needed first.

candidates.name: TrOCR (Microsoft)
candidates.pros: Modern transformer family; strongest open-source starting point for English handwriting; no Tesseract dependency.
candidates.cons: Heavier ML/runtime footprint; requires a custom page-to-text pipeline for archival PDF output.

candidates.name: PaddleOCR
candidates.pros: Broader OCR stack; active project; may handle mixed print+handwriting pages better.
candidates.cons: Heavier install; not a drop-in replacement; needs evaluation on microfilm-derived scans.

candidates.name: Kraken
candidates.pros: Strong historical-text and handwritten-text reputation; used in HTR research.
candidates.cons: Steeper workflow; less turnkey for desktop staff use; often requires model selection effort.

candidates.name: Calamari OCR
candidates.pros: Respected in historical and handwritten OCR circles; good for line-level workflows.
candidates.cons: Less page-oriented; may need segmentation or model work before use.

nextSteps: Gather a benchmark set of real English handwritten samples (plain cursive, mixed print/handwriting, noisy microfilm).
Run TrOCR and PaddleOCR against the benchmark set first.
Decide: separate HCR panel, or extended OCR panel with mode selector.
Evaluate installation complexity on Windows for each candidate.
Confirm feasibility of producing searchable PDF output without misleading text layers.

workflow: Run Auto Crop to remove scanner-created white space
Optionally run Add Border to add consistent margins
Merge correctly named TIFF page files into multi-page TIFFs
Use Split TIFFs when existing multi-page TIFFs need to be broken apart
Use OCR to PDF to build searchable grouped PDFs from page-image folders
Use PDF Conversion for size reduction, page extraction, and page-level exports
architecture: main.py — entry point for the app
gui/ — main window, panel controllers, shared dependency sidebar, theme system
modules/auto_cropping/ — OpenCV and Pillow crop logic
modules/ocr_pdf/ — OCR grouping, quality checks, searchable PDF generation
modules/pdf_tools/ — PDF size reduction, split, extract, and conversion logic
utils/worker.py — background workers, cancel flow, and progress callbacks
testing/ — per-tool fixture generators and assertion-based unittest suites
